professional_summary:
Full-stack software engineer with 6+ years of experience designing and building scalable web applications. Skilled in React.js 
and Next.js for responsive, accessible front-end interfaces, and in Node.js, Express, NestJS, and PHP (CodeIgniter) for 
building clean, modular back-end services. Experienced in designing and documenting REST APIs, integrating RabbitMQ for 
messaging, and using Redis/Memcached for caching to keep systems reliable at scale. Proficient across relational (MySQL, 
PostgreSQL) and NoSQL (MongoDB) data stores, including schema design, index optimization, and sharding. Proven track 
record mentoring junior developers, leading code reviews and knowledge-sharing sessions, and partnering with product 
owners to deliver production-ready features on time within Agile teams. 
CORE SKILLS 
JavaScript, TypeScript, PHP, React.js, Next.js, Node.js, Express, NestJS, CodeIgniter, MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB 
RabbitMQ, Redis, Memcached, REST API Design, Database Design, Code Reviews, Mentoring, Cisco Certified Network 
Associate - Routing and Switching (CCNA), Lambda, EC2, S3, RDS, SQS / SNS, Docker, Zoho API, QuickBooks API, Razorpay, 
Stripe, Langchain, Meta APIs
